title: Linz
place: Linz on the Danube, Upper Austria: the town, the bridge and Urfahr
about: walled town on the south bank of the Danube under the castle hill; wooded heights north of the river; flat ground south and east
notes: Relief: Terrarium (surface model) with woods and buildings filled from the fields around them.
The Linz harbour basins, 19th and 20th century (removed).
Woods, water and marsh: ESA WorldCover 2021, today's cover. Woods under 1.5 ha are dropped as orchards and hedgerows.
Villages: today's built-up cells (WorldCover) joined to a gazetteer point; their 1740 extent may differ.
Linz: walled town under the castle, about 0.6 km across (inferred extent).
Urfahr: market at the north end of the bridge (inferred extent).
Brooks: traced from the relief (catchment over 6 km2), not from a map; their courses are approximate.
sources: Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium; Mapzen, EU-DEM, SRTM)
Land cover: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 (CC BY 4.0)
Places: Overture Maps Foundation, divisions, release 2026-10-21.0 (ODbL; includes OpenStreetMap data)
